title: PromiseLedger Event
description: Append-only event log entry for the Promise Ledger. Each event records a state transition on a narrative promise. Ledger is per-book; stored in SQLite. No GO at chapter level if any promise is overdue.

promise_id.description: The promise being acted upon. Refs core/promise.schema.json.

event_type.description: 'broken' is a hard fail logged to the issue report.

agent_id.description: Agent that generated this event (e.g. writer_agent, convergence_controller).

details.description: Free-text summary of what happened (e.g. 'Chekhov pistol introduced in scene description').
